f.title: OND review staff use OCMQs for premarket safety evaluation and consistent signal detection
f.statement: Office of New Drugs (OND) Custom Medical Queries (OCMQs), formerly FDA Medical Queries (FMQs), are standardized groupings of similar adverse event terms intended to help identify potential safety issues during review of adverse event safety data. Although other groupings exist (for example Standardised MedDRA Queries, SMQs), OCMQs are clinically meaningful groupings used by OND staff for premarket safety evaluation, and their use promotes a consistent safety signal detection strategy across OND divisions.

f.title: OCMQs have Narrow and Broad components; some add an Algorithmic component described in a TAG
f.statement: OCMQs are provided to review teams with the Standard Safety Tables and Figures (ST&Fs) and in available review software. Each OCMQ has a Narrow and a Broad component; some OCMQs also have an Algorithmic component that uses additional information (combinations of adverse event terms instead of a single term, laboratory data, concomitant medications, medical history or timing information). Each algorithm is a series of criteria, and a patient who meets the specified criteria is counted as meeting the algorithm. Details of each Algorithmic OCMQ are in the associated Targeted Analysis Guide on the ST&F page.

OCMQs are available to review teams receiving Standard Safety Tables and Figures (ST&Fs) and in available review software.
 In addition to the Narrow and Broad components of each OCMQ, some OCMQs contain an Algorithmic component, which uses additional information to identify safety signals such as combinations of adverse event terms instead of a single term, laboratory data, concomitant medications, medical history, or timing information. Each Algorithm includes of a series of criteria, and patients who meet the specified criteria are considered to have met the requirement of the algorithm. For additional information about an Algorithmic OCMQ, see the associated Targeted Analysis Guide on the Standard Safety Tables and Figures (ST&Fs) Figures and Tables page .

f.title: Keep OCMQ groups under continual review for new MedDRA terms, with removals logged in a changelog
f.statement: OCMQ groups are continually reviewed for inclusion of new MedDRA terms and for the appropriateness of included terms, following the approach in MAPP 6025.8. The review may remove terms after re-evaluation, and every change from the previous version is recorded in the changelog.

f.title: Current OCMQ version uses terms from MedDRA v27.0 or earlier; updated versions released periodically
f.statement: The current OCMQ version includes terms released in MedDRA v27.0 or earlier. Updated OCMQ versions will be released periodically and reflected on the FDA OCMQ page, where the list of current OCMQs with their associated terms (Version 4.1) can be downloaded.

f.title: OCMQs also contain non-MedDRA terms from other terminologies and misspellings
f.statement: To make the groupings as comprehensive as possible, OCMQs include terms that have been submitted to FDA in clinical trial data sets that used other terminologies, as well as misspellings.
